influences.name: David Lynch
influences.context: Like many experimental musicians, the pair have an interest in durational cinema where gradual developments can dovetail and diverge in an almost symphonic way, and they've expressed a particular interest in David Lynch's work.

influences.name: Coil
influences.context: Autechre's heroes Coil created a weighty body of live work, particularly after they returned to gigs in the 2000s, and these became an important part of their artistic legacy.

influences.name: King Crimson
influences.context: The rigour of King Crimson's methods, their flat refusal to take the easy or obvious option without that leeway being earned, and the way that they plugged new sounds and instrumentation into their music to renew it at regular intervals, carries strong echoes of Ae.
